title: Pointwise approximation at each Chern-Simons bubble in the finite-height cluster setting
author: Youngae Lee and Lei Zhang
work: Non-simple blow-up for the Chern--Simons--Higgs equation: A priori analysis and constructions
difficulty_reason: Counted unit: original Theorem 5.1 of the article (source label prop:refined-profile, source0.tex lines 1307--1394): uniformly in the bubble index, the solution of the Chern-Simons-Higgs equation is approximated at each bubble point by the corresponding single-bubble profile together with the stated derivative estimates, in the refined form of the three assertions of the statement. It is delivered with the authors' own complete 527-line proof at source0.tex lines 2852--3378. H3: the proof is a 527-line multiscale analysis that the solver must reconstruct rather than quote: it suppresses the core indices, rewrites the equation in the rescaled variables around each bubble, splits the solution into the leading profile plus a small remainder, and then controls the remainder through the a priori estimates and the Pohozaev-type identities of the delivered context, keeping every constant uniform in the bubble index. Reproducing that uniform pointwise approximation at every bubble is research-level work well beyond ordinary PhD qualifying level.
